title: Australian-Style Outdoor Roasted Carrot Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy side dish featuring roasted carrots, perfect for outdoor gatherings. These skewers are easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, soy sauce, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped carrots to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the carrot pieces onto the Australian bush tomato skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the carrots are tender and lightly charred.
